settings.floor: 2 x median oracle latency of the batch-1 calls with L <= 256 (Table S-largewidth-calls); above floor: oracle latency > floor
settings.regret: per-call relative regret T(c) / T(c*) - 1 in percent unless stated; us_per_call absolute; ms_per_forward_pass = us_per_call x scan layers / 1000
settings.tied: chosen chunk in the call's statistical tie set (95% CI overlap, tied_chunks column)
settings.cv: within-block coefficient of variation std / mean of the 50 repeats of one (call, chunk) block; round-median view: between-round SD over the median
settings.predictors: e3_* trained on all calls with grouped 5-fold CV (prompt folds) and scored on the subset; best_static_insample chosen on all calls
